source: 人教版2019选择性必修四 Unit 4 词表(真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、志愿服务/慈善/分享/帮助他人主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义;跳过专有名词。

words.example_en: The volunteer was so happy to get a parcel from home.
words.example_cn: 那位志愿者收到家里寄来的包裹时非常高兴。

words.example_en: It is always nice to get mail when you live far away.
words.example_cn: 住在很远的地方时,收到信件总是令人开心。

words.example_en: She teaches science at a secondary school in a poor village.
words.example_cn: 她在一个贫困村庄的中学教科学。

words.example_en: The local boys do not even have cotton uniforms to wear.
words.example_cn: 当地的男孩们甚至没有棉布校服可穿。

words.example_en: Most students here cannot afford to wear a uniform.
words.example_cn: 这里大多数学生买不起校服。

words.example_en: The children have no laptops or tablets, only pencils and paper.
words.example_cn: 孩子们没有笔记本电脑或平板电脑,只有铅笔和纸。

words.example_en: All the students had were pencils, rubbers and paper.
words.example_cn: 学生们拥有的只有铅笔、橡皮和纸。

words.example_en: It is important not to be too rigid about the rules when you volunteer.
words.example_cn: 做志愿者时,对规则不要太死板,这一点很重要。

words.example_en: She felt it was a privilege to spend a day with the family.
words.example_cn: 她觉得能与这家人共度一天是一种荣幸。

words.example_en: The charity helps to build simple housing for poor families.
words.example_cn: 这家慈善机构帮助为贫困家庭建造简易住房。

words.example_en: Instead of wasting the leftovers, they shared them with neighbours.
words.example_cn: 他们没有浪费剩饭剩菜,而是分给了邻居。

words.example_en: We left the village after many goodbyes and firm handshakes.
words.example_cn: 在多次道别和有力的握手之后,我们离开了村庄。

words.example_en: Tired but happy, we dragged ourselves down the mountain towards home.
words.example_cn: 我们又累又开心,拖着身子下山往家走。

words.example_en: Her mother provides consultation and training for local doctors in Africa.
words.example_cn: 她母亲在非洲为当地医生提供咨询和培训。

words.meaning_cn: 感染(疾病);订立合同;合同
words.example_en: Many dangerous diseases are commonly contracted in that poor region.
words.example_cn: 许多危险的疾病在那个贫困地区很常见。

words.example_en: The volunteers help those with disabilities to live a fuller life.
words.example_cn: 志愿者们帮助残障人士过上更充实的生活。

words.example_en: After she retires, she hopes to continue to help the disabled.
words.example_cn: 退休后,她希望继续帮助残障人士。

words.example_en: She believes that everyone deserves a fair chance in life.
words.example_cn: 她相信每个人在生活中都应得到一个公平的机会。

words.example_en: He plans to resign from his job and work as a volunteer abroad.
words.example_cn: 他打算辞职,到国外做志愿者。

words.example_en: Today I want to relay to you how proud I am of my mother's work.
words.example_cn: 今天我想向你们转达我为母亲的工作感到多么自豪。

words.example_en: Helping other countries shows that we care about world stability.
words.example_cn: 帮助其他国家表明我们关心世界的稳定。

words.example_en: By any criterion, this kind of volunteer work is worth doing.
words.example_cn: 无论以何种标准衡量,这种志愿工作都值得去做。

words.example_en: She was upset that her mother left without asking for her input.
words.example_cn: 她很难过,母亲没有征求她的意见就离开了。

words.example_en: After hearing about her work, I began to sing a different tune.
words.example_cn: 听说了她的工作之后,我开始改变了看法。

words.example_en: An online platform lets people share things they no longer need.
words.example_cn: 一个在线平台让人们分享自己不再需要的物品。

words.example_en: Lately, more young people have joined volunteer projects.
words.example_cn: 最近,越来越多的年轻人加入了志愿项目。

words.example_en: I pray that you will help people in need, just as I have.
words.example_cn: 我企盼你也能像我一样帮助有需要的人。

words.example_en: We often take for granted things that poorer people lack.
words.example_cn: 我们常常把较贫困者所缺乏的东西视为理所当然。

words.example_en: We walked down a shaded path to the village in the valley.
words.example_cn: 我们沿着一条树荫遮蔽的小路走到谷中的村庄。

words.example_en: The dusty track to the school was covered in weeds.
words.example_cn: 通往学校那条尘土飞扬的小路上长满了杂草。

words.example_en: Every morning she walks to school along a dusty track.
words.example_cn: 每天早上她沿着一条尘土飞扬的小路走去学校。

words.example_en: The student's family lived in a small bamboo hut with no windows.
words.example_cn: 这名学生的家住在一间没有窗户的小竹棚里。

words.example_en: There was a fireplace in the centre of the small hut.
words.example_cn: 小屋的中央有一个壁炉。

words.example_en: The family's only possessions were a kettle, some cups and a few jars.
words.example_cn: 这家人仅有的财物是一个水壶、几个杯子和几个罐子。

words.example_en: Inside the parcel there was a jar of sweet jam from home.
words.example_cn: 包裹里有一罐家里寄来的甜果酱。

words.example_en: It was so nice to taste some sweets and jam from home again.
words.example_cn: 再次尝到家里寄来的糖果和果酱真是太好了。

words.example_en: She placed each cup carefully on its saucer for the guests.
words.example_cn: 她小心地把每个杯子放在杯托上招待客人。

words.example_en: The old farmer had a strong jaw and a wrinkled forehead.
words.example_cn: 那位老农有着坚毅的下巴和满是皱纹的额头。

words.example_en: The man with a strong jaw kindly led us to his house.
words.example_cn: 那个下巴坚毅的男人热心地把我们带到他家。

words.example_en: Years of hard work had left deep wrinkles on her face.
words.example_cn: 多年的辛勤劳作在她脸上留下了深深的皱纹。

words.example_en: Tombe threw the empty can out of the doorway of the hut.
words.example_cn: 通贝把空罐子从小屋的门口扔了出去。

words.example_en: They cooked the sweet potatoes in a single old pan.
words.example_cn: 他们用一个旧平底锅煮红薯。

words.example_en: He placed ripe corn and greens on the hot stones to steam.
words.example_cn: 他把成熟的玉米和青菜放在热石上蒸。

words.example_en: The mixture suddenly bubbled out of the test tube during the experiment.
words.example_cn: 实验中混合物突然从试管里冒了出来。

words.example_en: Since there was no washroom, she had to carry water from her house.
words.example_cn: 由于没有洗手间,她不得不从家里提水。

words.example_en: The bush classrooms have clay floors and roofs made of grass.
words.example_cn: 丛林里的教室有黏土地面和茅草屋顶。

words.example_en: The volunteer once had to plug holes in her roof to keep the rain out.
words.example_cn: 那位志愿者曾不得不堵住屋顶的洞以挡雨。

words.example_en: She noticed a can standing upside down on the grill over the fire.
words.example_cn: 她注意到火上的烤架上倒立着一个罐子。
